page.overview:
Who is Edmuda?

was a reiloran enforcer for the Dominion of Cruth's disciplinary division, The Will. As an NPC, she was played by Matthew Mercer.

Edmuda was a very tall, thin female reilora, with dark, shark-like eyes..}} When encountered by Bells Hells, she was wearing tangled robes and shoulder armor that curved upward at the tips, fancy enough to denote her station with ornate metals and bones.

Edmuda was proud and "particularly cruel", and had "a terrifyingly penetrating mind."

When the Imperium doubled production quotas in the outpost of Razora, Edmuda was sent there by the Dominion of Cruth as an enforcer. She was present in the place where the Bloody Bridge touched Ruidus, and joined a caravan of supplies with several members of the Ruby Vanguard, although she didn't speak much during the days it took to reach their destination.
